critiques.notes: This is a solid nighttime cityscape with good composition and attractive light patterns. The main issues are slightly blooming highlights that lose detail and marginally underexposed shadows. The color balance between cool sky tones and warm street lights is appealing and should be preserved. Focus on selective adjustments to enhance clarity while maintaining the cinematic nighttime mood.

critiques.notes: This cityscape has strong compositional foundation with good separation between elements. Primary issues are blown highlights in light sources and moderate noise in darker areas. The warm color palette and moody atmosphere are intentional and should be preserved while refining technical aspects for a more polished result.

improvements_detailed.action: Reduce highlights by -15 to -20 and bring down whites by -10 to recover blown detail in building lights and reflections

improvements_detailed.action: Lift shadows by +10 to +15 in the sky and water areas to reveal subtle detail while preserving the nighttime atmosphere
improvements_detailed.reason: Sky is very dark with minimal separation from buildings; gentle lift will add dimension without destroying the moody aesthetic

improvements_detailed.action: Apply luminance noise reduction (40-50%) particularly in shadow areas of sky and water
improvements_detailed.reason: Visible noise in darker areas detracts from the polished cityscape; reduction will create a cleaner, more professional look

improvements_detailed.reason: Helps focus attention on the illuminated skyline and creates better compositional flow
